title: Subsequence With the Minimum Score
summary: Given strings s and t, you can remove any characters from t.
statement: Given strings s and t, you can remove any characters from t. The score is the difference between the maximum and minimum indices of removed characters plus one, if any are removed. Otherwise, the score is zero. Find the minimum score to make t a subsequence of s by removing characters.
constraints: Remove any characters from t so the remainder becomes a subsequence of s.
The score is last removed index minus first removed index plus one, or zero if none are removed.
reference_solution:
def minimum_subsequence_removal_score(s,t):
    n=len(t);prefix=[-1]*n;suffix=[-1]*n
    position=0
    for index,char in enumerate(t):
        found=s.find(char,position)
        if found<0:break
        prefix[index]=found;position=found+1
    position=len(s)
    for index in range(n-1,-1,-1):
        found=s.rfind(t[index],0,position)
        if found<0:break
        suffix[index]=found;position=found
    answer=n;right=0
    for left in range(-1,n):
        if left>=0 and prefix[left]<0:break
        right=max(right,left+1)
        while right<n and (suffix[right]<0 or suffix[right]<=(-1 if left<0 else prefix[left])):right+=1
        answer=min(answer,right-left-1)
    return answer
